text: DSH Cache Hit Decimal 是 DSH 网页客户端的会话统计插件。它替换对话撰写区原生统计槽位，以两位小数显示缓存命中率，并列出轮数、步骤、模型与工具耗时、首 token 时间、生成速度和输入输出 token 数。数据取自会话统计与 token 用量投影，部分缺失时会从旧会话节点推导。适合希望在网页对话中查看精确缓存比例和运行统计的用户；无需额外密钥、账号或服务配置。

DSH Cache Hit Decimal adds session stats to the DSH web composer. It replaces the native stats slot and shows cache-hit rate to two decimals, timing, generation speed, and token totals. It reads session usage projections with a legacy fallback. No extra key or account is needed.
想在 DSH 网页上看到缓存命中率的精确百分比。
能不能把对话统计里的缓存率显示到小数点后两位？
我想在网页会话里同时查看 token 用量、响应耗时和生成速度。
Can I see cache hit percentage with two decimal places in the web chat?
I want session turn counts, token totals, and response timing visible together.
How can I check the cache share without rounding a partial hit up to 100 percent?
DSH Cache Hit Decimal 的功能「精确缓存命中率」：在网页对话撰写区的统计栏显示缓存读取 token 占输入 token 的百分比，默认保留两位小数；部分命中不会显示成 100%。随会话 token 用量自动更新。
DSH Cache Hit Decimal 的功能「会话统计栏」：网页会话撰写区显示轮数、步骤数、模型和工具耗时、首 token 平均时间、生成速度及输入输出 token 数。数据来自统计和用量投影，缺失时可从旧会话节点推导。

@yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal README · dsh-cache-hit-decimal：> **Discontinued (2026-09-12) — the official client now does this.**
> DeepSeek Harness renders the cache-hit rate with two decimals on its own: the official
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` package ships the `cache-hit-2dp` formatting (verified in
> `0.1.5-rc.2`) and uses it in both the composer stats line and the turn-usage panel. That was
> this plugin's only purpose, so it is redundant now — **this repository is no longer updated and
> no further versions will be published.** The last published release (`0.2.0`) stays on npm for
> older runtimes; everything below is kept for reference.

@yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal
```

Restart the `dsh web` process and refresh the browser.

@yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal README · Update：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal
```

Restart `dsh web` and refresh the browser. If a configured npm mirror has not synced the latest version yet, use the official registry:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

pnpm 11 may delay newly published versions for 24 hours. To update immediately:

cd dsh-cache-hit-decimal
pnpm install
pnpm build
@yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal README · 0.2.1：Fixes the line being invisible on current DeepSeek Harness (verified against `0.1.5-rc.1`), and makes the two-decimal promise actually hold.
@yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal README · 0.1.4：- Display the full stats line on one centered row without wrapping or an ellipsis.
@yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal README · 0.1.3：- Display the cache-hit rate with two decimal places.

@yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal
```

Restart `dsh web`. The native integer `StatsLine` becomes the active slot occupant again.

@yuuu0109/dsh-cache-hit-decimal README · Development：```sh

pnpm build
```

Compatibility is pinned to DeepSeek Harness `0.1.5-rc.1` (client packages `0.1.5-rc.2`) and React 18.

This is an independent community plugin and is not part of the official DeepSeek Harness repository.
